name: Homework: Ch8 Probability (8.1, 8.2, 8.4 mixed)

coverage_spec: 8.1.1 Sample Spaces — count outcomes; identify equally likely
8.1.2 Events and Their Probability — compute P(E) for a defined event
8.1.3 Computing Probabilities by Counting — apply n(E)/n(S) with counted outcomes
8.2.1 Set Operations on Events — union, intersection, complement on event sets
8.2.2 Mutually Exclusive Events — recognize when P(A ∩ B) = 0
8.2.3 The Addition Rule for Probability — apply P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A ∩ B)
8.2.4 Two-Way Tables and the Addition Rule — read marginals and apply addition rule from a table
8.4.1 What 'Given That' Means — interpret conditional language; identify B in P(A|B)
8.4.2 Computing Conditional Probability from a Reduced Sample Space
8.4.3 The Conditional Probability Formula — apply P(A|B) = P(A ∩ B) / P(B)

questions.title: P(exactly one head) on n coins
questions.process_step: enumerate event outcomes; divide by sample space

questions.title: P(sum = k) on two dice
questions.process_step: count favorable ordered pairs; divide by 36

questions.title: Three children — exactly 2 boys & at least one boy

questions.process_step: construct union, intersection, and complement of event sets

questions.title: Mutually exclusive: yes/no for 3 pairs
questions.process_step: test whether E ∩ F = ∅ for several event pairs

questions.title: Addition Rule from word-problem percentages
questions.process_step: apply P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A ∩ B)

questions.title: P(king or heart) on a card draw
questions.process_step: apply addition rule on 52-card deck with named overlap

questions.title: Two-way table — P(A∩B), P(A∪B)

questions.process_step: read marginals; apply addition rule from table

questions.title: P(2 boys | first-born is boy) — reduced sample space
